sources.quote: Starting July 30, GPT-5.6 Luna costs 80% less, while GPT-5.6 Terra costs 20% less. See [pricing details](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing).
sources.supports: OpenAI announced the GPT-5.6 Luna price reduction as starting July 30, establishing a provider price change effective that day.

notes: OpenAI's changelog directly states that GPT-5.6 Luna costs 80% less starting July 30, supporting a genuine provider price change. It gives the effective date but no time or timezone.
